name: gripe-miner
description: Gripe Miner + Session Patterns + Automate: mines your own Claude Code transcripts three ways — moments you got frustrated, loops that keep repeating (stuck points, re-explaining, deferred fixes, re-setup), and the asks you keep retyping by hand together with the tokens they burn — each verified against your code and written to a ranked backlog; the third lens proposes the cheapest durable automation for each repeated ask (skill, hook, script, scheduled routine, CLAUDE.md line, MCP connector).
